label: TP
reason: Alert 1 alert-TP: User-controlled 'seg' parameter flows directly to redirect URL at line 24 without validation. Resolved sink value = "https://" + host + "/" + seg where seg = request.getParameter("seg") or default "home". Although host has regex validation, the path segment 'seg' is unvalidated and allows path traversal/open redirect attacks. Attacker can set seg="../secret" or similar payloads to navigate outside intended scope.

evidence.note: User-controlled 'seg' parameter flows to redirect URL without sanitization; host regex only protects domain portion, not path segment
